topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations, adaptive beamforming, power allocation, and frequency-dependent beam steering are essential. These strategies optimize gain stability, minimize interference, and counteract beam squint effects. Machine learning integration predicts beam squint, enabling proactive adjustments. Quantization-aware training ensures reliable performance in resource-constrained environments.
reference_context: Max beam gain is 51.8 dBi, noise power density is -204 dBW/MHz, informing beam management strategies.
